name: Kaingin
description: A swidden plot at the forest's edge growing ube, tugi and dawa. After several harvests the soil tires: rest it, let the forest grow back, and clear a new plot.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Costs, staffing and yields are playtest guesses (npm run simulate)
